For over 165 years, Chisholm Hunter has expertly curated the finest diamonds and timepieces, and their Canary Wharf location has been meticulously designed to offer an unforgettable luxury experience. As an authorised retailer for some of the world’s most prestigious watchmakers, they are incredibly proud to feature immersive, dedicated boutiques to TUDOR, OMEGA, IWC, Glashütte Original, Tissot, MIDO, and Hamilton. Here, horology enthusiasts can explore exceptional collections and iconic timepieces, guided by their passionate experts.

Experience “A Cut Above” with their bespoke diamond services and luxury watch ambassadors. Step into our elegant private viewing suite today for a personal consultation and let our experts guide you.
